categories.title: Direction and movement
categories.description: Arrows and chevrons that move through pages, steps, lists and sections.

categories.title: Actions
categories.description: Things a person does to content: add, remove, copy, upload, search and undo.

categories.title: Status and feedback
categories.description: The state of a message, a task or a case, always shown together with words.

categories.title: Interface controls
categories.description: Menus, settings, views, visibility and media controls in an interface.

categories.title: Text editing
categories.description: Formatting, lists, alignment, links and code in the rich text editor.

categories.title: Tables and data
categories.description: Tables, the table tools of the editor, and charts of figures.

categories.title: Documents and files
categories.description: Documents, forms, attachments, images, certificates and folders.

categories.title: Communication
categories.description: Email, phone, chat, notifications, news and sending a message.

categories.title: People and identity
categories.description: People, accounts, identification, signing in and verified identity.

categories.title: Time and date
categories.description: Dates, times, appointments, time limits and history.

categories.title: Maps and places
categories.description: Maps, places, routes, map navigation and public buildings.

categories.title: Money and payments
categories.description: Paying, invoices, receipts and benefits paid out.

categories.title: Care, health and education
categories.description: Welfare services: health care, social care, schools and work.

categories.title: Mobility and environment
categories.description: Transport, streets, waste, water, energy and nature.

categories.title: Safety, law and civic life
categories.description: Security, privacy, emergencies, law and elections.

categories.title: Language and access
categories.description: Language, accessibility, display settings, reading aloud and captions.

icons.name: arrow-back
icons.meaning: Go back: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: arrow-forward
icons.meaning: Go on, start or continue: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline end.

icons.name: chevron-back
icons.meaning: Previous, towards the inline start: a chevron pointing back.

icons.name: chevron-down
icons.meaning: Open or show what is below: a chevron pointing down.

icons.name: chevron-forward
icons.meaning: Next, towards the inline end: a chevron pointing forward.

icons.name: chevron-up
icons.meaning: Close or show what is above: a chevron pointing up.

icons.name: collapse-all
icons.meaning: Close every section at once: two chevrons pointing towards each other.

icons.name: expand-all
icons.meaning: Open every section at once: two chevrons pointing away from each other.

icons.name: external
icons.meaning: Opens somewhere else: an arrow leaving an open frame at its inline-end top.

icons.name: first
icons.meaning: Go to the first page or item: a chevron pointing back against a bar.

icons.name: last
icons.meaning: Go to the last page or item: a chevron pointing forward against a bar.

icons.name: refresh
icons.meaning: Load again or try again: a circular arrow.

icons.name: add
icons.meaning: Add, add another or zoom in: a plus.

icons.name: check
icons.meaning: Selected or completed: a check mark.

icons.name: close
icons.meaning: Close, dismiss or clear: two crossed diagonal strokes.

icons.name: copy
icons.meaning: Copy to the clipboard: two equal sheets, one in front of the other.
icons.label: icons.copy

icons.name: cut
icons.meaning: Cut to the clipboard: open scissors.

icons.name: delete
icons.meaning: Delete for good: a waste bin with a lid and a handle.

icons.name: download
icons.meaning: Save a file to the device: an arrow going down into an open tray.
icons.label: icons.download

icons.name: edit
icons.meaning: Change something: a pencil at 45 degrees, tip down.

icons.name: paste
icons.meaning: Paste from the clipboard: a board with a clip over its top edge.

icons.name: print
icons.meaning: Print: a printer with a sheet coming out of it.

icons.name: redo
icons.meaning: Redo the change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline end.

icons.name: remove
icons.meaning: Remove one, decrease or zoom out: a minus.

icons.name: search
icons.meaning: Search: a magnifying glass, its handle to the lower inline end.
icons.label: icons.search

icons.name: share
icons.meaning: Share with others: three small rings joined in a V by two lines.

icons.name: undo
icons.meaning: Undo the last change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline start.

icons.name: upload
icons.meaning: Send a file from the device: an arrow rising out of an open tray.
icons.label: icons.upload

icons.name: attention
icons.meaning: Needs your action: an exclamation mark, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.attention

icons.name: blocked
icons.meaning: Blocked or not allowed: a barrier, a bar on two posts, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.blocked

icons.name: error
icons.meaning: Something is wrong: an octagon with a small cross.
icons.label: icons.error

icons.name: help
icons.meaning: Help and support: a lifebuoy ring with four bands, never a question mark; glyph only with no container (the ring is the object), always with words.
icons.label: icons.help

icons.name: in-progress
icons.meaning: Being handled now: an open three-quarter arc with no arrowhead, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.inProgress

icons.name: info
icons.meaning: Information, good to know: a rounded square with a dot over a stem.
icons.label: icons.info

icons.name: new
icons.meaning: New or recently added: a four-pointed sparkle, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.new

icons.name: pending
icons.meaning: Waiting, not started yet: an hourglass, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.pending

icons.name: success
icons.meaning: Success or done: a circle with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.success

icons.name: warning
icons.meaning: Take care: a triangle with an exclamation mark.
icons.label: icons.warning

icons.name: drag-handle
icons.meaning: Move by dragging: six large dots in two columns of three.

icons.name: eye
icons.meaning: Show a hidden value: an open eye.

icons.name: eye-off
icons.meaning: Hide a shown value: an open eye with a slash broken around the pupil.

icons.name: filter
icons.meaning: Filter the results: a funnel with its stem cut at 45 degrees.

icons.name: fullscreen
icons.meaning: Enter full screen: four corner marks at the square keyline.

icons.name: fullscreen-exit
icons.meaning: Leave full screen: four corner marks turned inwards.

icons.name: lock
icons.meaning: Locked or secure: a closed padlock.
icons.label: icons.lock

icons.name: menu
icons.meaning: Open the navigation menu: three equal horizontal lines.
icons.label: icons.menu

icons.name: more
icons.meaning: More actions or options: three large dots in a row.

icons.name: more-vertical
icons.meaning: More actions for one row: three large dots stacked.

icons.name: pause
icons.meaning: Pause playback: two upright bars.

icons.name: play
icons.meaning: Start or resume playback: a triangle pointing right, which follows the media, not the script.

icons.name: settings
icons.meaning: Settings: a gear with eight teeth around a hub.

icons.name: sort
icons.meaning: Sortable, not sorted yet: an up arrow and a down arrow side by side.

icons.name: stop
icons.meaning: Stop playback: a rounded square.

icons.name: unlock
icons.meaning: Unlocked: a padlock with its shackle open.
icons.label: icons.unlock

icons.name: view-grid
icons.meaning: Show as a grid: four rounded tiles, two by two.

icons.name: align-center
icons.meaning: Centre the text: four lines, long and short, centred.

icons.name: align-end
icons.meaning: Align the text to the end: four lines flush to the inline end.

icons.name: align-start
icons.meaning: Align the text to the start: four lines flush to the inline start.

icons.name: bold
icons.meaning: Make text bold: a heavy bar between two thin text lines.

icons.name: bullet-list
icons.meaning: A bulleted list: three large dots at the inline start, each with a text line.

icons.name: checklist
icons.meaning: A list of tasks to tick: two rows, each a small check and a text line.

icons.name: clear-formatting
icons.meaning: Remove all formatting: the heavy bar of bold with a small cross.

icons.name: code
icons.meaning: Inline code: a pair of angle brackets.

icons.name: code-block
icons.meaning: A block of code: small angle brackets inside a landscape frame.

icons.name: highlight
icons.meaning: Highlight text: a highlighter pen at 45 degrees over a baseline.

icons.name: indent
icons.meaning: Increase the indent: four lines, the middle two moved in, a small chevron to the end.

icons.name: italic
icons.meaning: Make text italic: a bar leaning forward between two thin text lines.

icons.name: justify
icons.meaning: Justify the text: four equal full-width lines.

icons.name: link
icons.meaning: A link: two chain links on the 45 degree axis.

icons.name: link-off
icons.meaning: Remove a link: the outer halves of two chain links, parted by a slash.

icons.name: numbered-list
icons.meaning: A numbered list: rows marked with one, two and three tally ticks.

icons.name: outdent
icons.meaning: Decrease the indent: as indent, the chevron pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: quote
icons.meaning: A quotation block: a bar at the inline start beside three text lines.

icons.name: strike
icons.meaning: Strike text through: a word box with a rule through it.

icons.name: text-color
icons.meaning: Change the colour of text: an ink drop over a baseline.

icons.name: underline
icons.meaning: Underline text: a word box with a rule beneath it.

icons.name: chart-bar
icons.meaning: Figures compared: three upright bars of different heights on a baseline.
icons.label: icons.chartBar

icons.name: chart-line
icons.meaning: A change over time: a line with two bends above a baseline.
icons.label: icons.chartLine

icons.name: chart-pie
icons.meaning: Parts of a whole: a circle cut into slices by two radii.
icons.label: icons.chartPie

icons.name: database
icons.meaning: A store of data: a cylinder with two bands.
icons.label: icons.database

icons.name: table
icons.meaning: A table: a landscape frame with a header rule, a row rule and a column.
icons.label: icons.table

icons.name: table-column-add
icons.meaning: Add a column: the frame with column rules and a small plus.

icons.name: table-column-remove
icons.meaning: Delete a column: the frame with column rules and a small minus.

icons.name: table-merge
icons.meaning: Merge cells: two arrows from the frame sides meeting where the column breaks.

icons.name: table-row-add
icons.meaning: Add a row: the frame with row rules and a small plus.

icons.name: table-row-remove
icons.meaning: Delete a row: the frame with row rules and a small minus.

icons.name: table-split
icons.meaning: Split a cell: two arrows from a whole column out to the frame sides.

icons.name: archive
icons.meaning: Stored for keeping: a box with a lid and a label slot.
icons.label: icons.archive

icons.name: attachment
icons.meaning: A file attached: an upright paper clip.
icons.label: icons.attachment

icons.name: certificate
icons.meaning: Proof or permission granted: a page with a round seal and a ribbon.
icons.label: icons.certificate

icons.name: document
icons.meaning: A document or a file: a page with a folded corner and two text lines.
icons.label: icons.document

icons.name: document-check
icons.meaning: A completed or approved document: the document with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.documentCheck

icons.name: folder
icons.meaning: A case or a collection of files: a folder with a tab.
icons.label: icons.folder

icons.name: form
icons.meaning: A form to fill in, or an application: a page with two input boxes.
icons.label: icons.form

icons.name: image
icons.meaning: An image: a landscape frame with a peak and a ring as the sun.
icons.label: icons.image

icons.name: signature
icons.meaning: Sign something: a pen above a written line.
icons.label: icons.signature

icons.name: chat
icons.meaning: A conversation or feedback: a speech bubble.
icons.label: icons.chat

icons.name: mail
icons.meaning: Email or a message: an envelope.
icons.label: icons.mail

icons.name: mobile
icons.meaning: A mobile phone or a text message: an upright phone with a speaker line.
icons.label: icons.mobile

icons.name: news
icons.meaning: News and announcements: a folded newspaper.
icons.label: icons.news

icons.name: notification
icons.meaning: Notifications: a bell.
icons.label: icons.notification

icons.name: notification-off
icons.meaning: Notifications off: the bell with a slash.
icons.label: icons.notificationOff

icons.name: phone
icons.meaning: Call by phone: a telephone handset.
icons.label: icons.phone

icons.name: send
icons.meaning: Send a message: a paper plane flying to the inline end.

icons.name: video-call
icons.meaning: A video call or a remote appointment: a video camera.
icons.label: icons.videoCall

icons.name: account
icons.meaning: Your own account: a head and shoulders inside a circle.
icons.label: icons.account

icons.name: family
icons.meaning: A family or a household: a larger and a smaller figure side by side.
icons.label: icons.family

icons.name: id-card
icons.meaning: Identification: a card with a portrait and two lines.
icons.label: icons.idCard

icons.name: key
icons.meaning: Access or a password: a key.
icons.label: icons.key

icons.name: people
icons.meaning: A group of people: two head-and-shoulders figures, one behind the other.
icons.label: icons.people

icons.name: person
icons.meaning: One person: a head and shoulders, no gender or age.
icons.label: icons.person

icons.name: person-add
icons.meaning: Add a person: the person with a small plus.

icons.name: sign-in
icons.meaning: Sign in: an arrow entering a door frame towards the inline end.

icons.name: sign-out
icons.meaning: Sign out: an arrow leaving a door frame towards the inline end.

icons.name: verified
icons.meaning: Verified or trusted: a shield with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.verified

icons.name: calendar
icons.meaning: A date, or choosing one: a page with two binding rings, a header and three dots.
icons.label: icons.calendar

icons.name: calendar-add
icons.meaning: Add to a calendar: the calendar with a small plus.

icons.name: calendar-check
icons.meaning: A booked appointment or a confirmed date: the calendar with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.calendarCheck

icons.name: clock
icons.meaning: A time of day or opening hours: a clock face with two hands.
icons.label: icons.clock

icons.name: history
icons.meaning: What happened before: a clock face with an arrow turning back around it.
icons.label: icons.history

icons.name: repeat
icons.meaning: Happens again on a schedule: two arrows chasing each other in a loop.
icons.label: icons.repeat

icons.name: timer
icons.meaning: A time limit or a deadline: a stopwatch.
icons.label: icons.timer

icons.name: area
icons.meaning: An area on the map, or drawing one: a five-sided outline with ring handles at three corners.

icons.name: arrow-east
icons.meaning: Move the map east: an arrow pointing right, which never mirrors.

icons.name: arrow-north
icons.meaning: Move the map north: an arrow pointing up.

icons.name: arrow-south
icons.meaning: Move the map south: an arrow pointing down.

icons.name: arrow-west
icons.meaning: Move the map west: an arrow pointing left, which never mirrors.

icons.name: building
icons.meaning: An office building or an organisation: a block with rows of windows.
icons.label: icons.building

icons.name: city-hall
icons.meaning: The municipality's office: a building with a pediment and columns.
icons.label: icons.cityHall

icons.name: directions
icons.meaning: Get directions to a place: a route from a start ring, with two bends, to an arrowhead.

icons.name: distance
icons.meaning: A distance, or measuring one: three ring handles joined by a straight line.

icons.name: home
icons.meaning: A home, where someone lives: a house with a pitched roof and a door.
icons.label: icons.home

icons.name: layers
icons.meaning: The layers shown on the map: three stacked sheets seen at an angle.

icons.name: locate
icons.meaning: Show my location: a target, a ring with four ticks and a large dot.

icons.name: locate-off
icons.meaning: My location is unavailable: the target with a short slash in place of the dot.

icons.name: map
icons.meaning: A map, the map view or the map type: a paper map folded in three panels.
icons.label: icons.map

icons.name: pin
icons.meaning: A place on a map: an outline teardrop pin with a round hole.
icons.label: icons.pin

icons.name: pin-add
icons.meaning: Add a place or set a point: the pin with a small plus.

icons.name: terrain
icons.meaning: Terrain, a relief map: two peaks on a baseline.

icons.name: zoom-to-fit
icons.meaning: Show the whole map with every place: corner marks around a small circle.

icons.name: benefit
icons.meaning: Money paid out to you: an open hand under a coin.
icons.label: icons.benefit

icons.name: invoice
icons.meaning: A bill to pay: a page with text lines and a total rule.
icons.label: icons.invoice

icons.name: payment
icons.meaning: Pay: a bank card with a stripe.
icons.label: icons.payment

icons.name: receipt
icons.meaning: Proof of payment: a slip with a zigzag bottom edge.
icons.label: icons.receipt

icons.name: book
icons.meaning: Reading or the library: a closed book.
icons.label: icons.book

icons.name: care
icons.meaning: Social care: a heart held in an open hand.
icons.label: icons.care

icons.name: education
icons.meaning: Education and schools: a graduation cap.
icons.label: icons.education

icons.name: health
icons.meaning: Health care: a stethoscope.
icons.label: icons.health

icons.name: job
icons.meaning: Work and jobs: a briefcase.
icons.label: icons.job

icons.name: meal
icons.meaning: Meals and food: a fork and a knife side by side.
icons.label: icons.meal

icons.name: medication
icons.meaning: Medicine: a capsule split across its middle.
icons.label: icons.medication

icons.name: vaccination
icons.meaning: A vaccination: a syringe.
icons.label: icons.vaccination

icons.name: bike
icons.meaning: A bicycle seen from the side.
icons.label: icons.bike

icons.name: bus
icons.meaning: A bus seen from the front.
icons.label: icons.bus

icons.name: car
icons.meaning: A car seen from the front.
icons.label: icons.car

icons.name: energy
icons.meaning: Electricity and energy: a lightning bolt.
icons.label: icons.energy

icons.name: ferry
icons.meaning: A ferry on the water.
icons.label: icons.ferry

icons.name: recycle
icons.meaning: Recycling: three arrows chasing each other around a triangle.
icons.label: icons.recycle

icons.name: repair
icons.meaning: Repair, or report a fault: a wrench.
icons.label: icons.repair

icons.name: roadworks
icons.meaning: Roadworks: a traffic cone.
icons.label: icons.roadworks

icons.name: snow
icons.meaning: Snow and snow clearing: a six-armed snowflake.
icons.label: icons.snow

icons.name: train
icons.meaning: A train seen from the front.
icons.label: icons.train

icons.name: tree
icons.meaning: Parks and nature: a tree.
icons.label: icons.tree

icons.name: walk
icons.meaning: On foot: a walking figure.
icons.label: icons.walk

icons.name: waste
icons.meaning: Waste collection: a wheeled bin with a lid.
icons.label: icons.waste

icons.name: water
icons.meaning: Water and the water supply: a tap with a drop.
icons.label: icons.water

icons.name: emergency
icons.meaning: An emergency or an alarm: a beacon light with rays.
icons.label: icons.emergency

icons.name: fire
icons.meaning: Fire: a flame.
icons.label: icons.fire

icons.name: law
icons.meaning: Law and rights: a pair of balance scales.
icons.label: icons.law

icons.name: privacy
icons.meaning: Personal data protection: a shield with a head and shoulders inside.
icons.label: icons.privacy

icons.name: quick-exit
icons.meaning: Leave this site quickly: a figure running out through a doorway.

icons.name: shield
icons.meaning: Security or protection: a shield.
icons.label: icons.shield

icons.name: vote
icons.meaning: Voting: a ballot going through the slot of a box.
icons.label: icons.vote

icons.name: accessibility
icons.meaning: Accessibility: the standard figure with open arms inside a circle.
icons.label: icons.accessibility

icons.name: captions
icons.meaning: Captions: a frame with two short text lines at its foot.
icons.label: icons.captions

icons.name: contrast
icons.meaning: Contrast and display settings: a circle with its right half drawn as diagonal stripes, outline only, no fill.

icons.name: dark-mode
icons.meaning: Dark mode: a half-moon disc, a circle with an inner arc, not a crescent.

icons.name: keyboard
icons.meaning: A keyboard and its shortcuts: a keyboard seen from above.
icons.label: icons.keyboard

icons.name: language
icons.meaning: Change language: a globe with a meridian and two latitude lines, never a flag.
icons.label: icons.language

icons.name: light-mode
icons.meaning: Light mode: a sun.

icons.name: read-aloud
icons.meaning: Listen to the page read aloud: a speaker with sound waves.

icons.name: sign-language
icons.meaning: Content in sign language: two hands signing, drawn only if it meets the detail budget and the no-gestures rule at 20px, else cut.
icons.label: icons.signLanguage

icons.name: text-size
icons.meaning: Text size: stepped bars rising in height, no letters.
